title: AGSA-Net: Abundance-Guided Self-Attention Network for Spectral Unmixing-Aware Hyperspectral Remote Sensing Image Classification
abstract: arXiv:2609.06359v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hyperspectral image (HSI) classification plays a vital role in remote sensing applications, including agriculture, environmental monitoring, and urban analysis. However, its performance remains challenged by high spectral redundancy, noise sensitivity, and the difficulty of jointly modeling local material composition and long-range spectral dependencies. To address this, we propose AGSA-Net, an abundance-guided self-attention network that explicitly integrates spectral unmixing priors into the classification process. AGSA Net first estimates physically meaningful subpixel abundance maps subject to non-negativity and sum-to-one constraints, regularized by hybrid linear-nonlinear reconstruction decoder. The learned abundances are then used to construct an abundance affinity prior that guides a spectral transformer to emphasize class-discriminative interactions, and the resulting transformer features are fused with compact abundance descr

translated_title: AGSA-Net：面向光谱解混感知高光谱遥感图像分类的丰度引导自注意力网络
translated_abstract: 高光谱图像（HSI）分类在农业、环境监测和城市分析等遥感应用中发挥着至关重要的作用。然而，其性能仍面临高光谱冗余、噪声敏感性，以及难以联合建模局部物质组成与长程光谱依赖性等挑战。为解决这些问题，我们提出了AGSA-Net，一种丰度引导的自注意力网络，将光谱解混先验显式地整合到分类过程中。AGSA-Net首先在非负性与和为一约束条件下估计具有物理意义的亚像元丰度图，并通过线性-非线性混合重建解码器进行正则化。随后，学习到的丰度被用于构建丰度亲和先验，引导光谱Transformer强化类别判别性交互，并将所得的Transformer特征与紧凑的丰度描述符进行融合……
tldr: 提出丰度引导自注意力网络AGSA-Net，将光谱解混先验显式融入高光谱图像分类，利用丰度亲和先验引导光谱Transformer强化类别判别性特征的建模与融合。
en_tdlr: AGSA-Net is proposed as an abundance-guided self-attention network that explicitly incorporates spectral unmixing priors into HSI classification, using an abundance affinity prior to guide a spectral transformer for enhanced class-discriminative feature modeling and fusion.
